query: Which sequential mixed-methods integration design (e.g., explanatory sequential, exploratory sequential, convergent) will best link ethnography to classifier training and causal model refinement?

response.query: Which sequential mixed-methods integration design (e.g., explanatory sequential, exploratory sequential, convergent) will best link ethnography to classifier training and causal model refinement?
response.answer: Explanatory sequential design best links ethnography to classifier training and causal model refinement by first using quantitative data for initial analysis, then enriching it with qualitative insights from ethnography.
